description: Read this FIRST. Returns your account overview: token scopes (live/exchange), which exchanges your token can call at all (callable), which of those allow a real live order right now vs. force a dry-run for lack of an active subscription (live_allowed/dry_run_forced, with upgrade_url when forced), per-exchange facts (id, whether it is free, whether it is a paper/no-real-money venue, whether the `link` tool accepts it (linkable), the parameters its integration lists as unsupported (unsupported_parameters), its setup_url and its required credential labels (credentials)), and your hooks with their linked exchanges. If no hook is linked to any exchange yet, recommended_first_exchange points at a free paper venue to start with. failing_hooks flags any hook whose last several alerts all failed with the SAME error (a stuck webhook loop). Requires your Autoview account token.

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).
